description: This file is a Python module that provides a framework for testing translation files (.po and .mo files). It includes functions for loading test modules, running tests on translation files, and modifying the LINGUAS file to remove specific languages. It also contains logic to handle test failures by cleaning up related files.

methods.name: _remove_lingua
methods.description: Removes a specified language from the LINGUAS file by reading, modifying, and rewriting the file.

methods.name: testFile
methods.description: Runs all registered translation tests against a specified .mo file, optionally removing the file and updating LINGUAS on failure in release mode.

methods.name: testSourceTree
methods.description: Runs all registered translation tests against all .po files in a given directory, optionally in release mode with cleanup.
